domain: battery diagnostics and laboratory data integration
title: DLR lithium-graphite cell GITT and quasi-open-circuit measurements
publisher: Zenodo; originating researchers: Clark, Simon (SINTEF); Tolchard, Julian (SINTEF Industry); Kopljar, Dennis (German Aerospace Center); Schmitt, Christina (German Aerospace Center); Barbers, Elias (Forschungszentrum Jülich)
deterministic_selection_rule: Complete GITT and POCV Basytec exports for the same DLR LiGrHydra0b cell at 25 deg C, plus full original multi-file metadata.json. Other cells/vendors and source files explicitly labeled Time_Bug/Outlier_Bug excluded by this cell-level selection.

substitution.original_title: Yellowstone geyser water, chemistry and meteorological campaign
substitution.reason: Four public JPEG attachments have persistent publisher MD5 mismatches despite matching byte counts. The mismatch was reproduced through the named-file route; the parent image also mismatched in the official all-files ZIP. Numerical files passed, but the planned full bundle did not meet strict checksum admission. Approved DLR reserve used.

measurement_dates.description: Basytec headers: GITT 2022-11-14 10:40:01 to 2022-12-10 02:27:48; POCV 2023-01-31 19:39:26 to 2023-02-06 18:20:34. Both exports were converted by source software on 2025-09-05; repository publication 2025-10-08.
measurement_dates.status: explicit native instrument-export headers; source timezone unspecified

author_preprocessing: Original laboratory battery-cycler exports. The broader source record includes files explicitly labeled with time/outlier bugs for pipeline testing; those are not selected. Full metadata describes both selected and omitted files.
known_analyses_and_limitations: This DLR record was released for battery data-pipeline and workflow testing. GITT and POCV belong to the same cell at different times and are not independent cells. The metadata includes other laboratories/files not present in this coherent subset. Absolute state of charge and history depend on source protocol and capacity definitions.
